verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm selling legal services, so an official CLI is outside its product category. The evidence describes client extranets, AI review tools, dashboards and Fenwick Labs web services, but nothing shows a shipped command-line tool that would make the axis apply. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
